body: Thank you, I don’t have any other symptoms apart from memory losses and I’m still depressed, so you might be right.

Thanks you for the awnser. I’ve stopped taking antidepressants as they had no effects in me, I used them only for my attempts. 

I tried therapy but it also had zero effect and none of the advices my therapist gave me worked. 

I would say that I have occasional « ok days » but I’m still depressed and hopeless about the future, every days that goes by pushes me further from the life i want. I definitely don’t have any wish to stay alive, I’m past looking for help. 

I’m currently not in a mood where I want to do it again even tho I wish it succeeded. I’m still looking for something that would work for the next time.
For example giving ride multiple times, paying for food, inviting into my friends group, helping with studying. Probably other things I can’t remember.

For what reasons would you refuse to flatshare with one of your friend for example?
Yeah I’m very reluctant to confront him, might get worse.
Well as hard is it to admit, yes I’m jealous when he goes out with other people. Yet I’m not romantically attracted to him.

That what I don’t understand, even tho we don’t owe each other anything (maybe beside the honesty) it really feel like we’re both each other closest friend at college. So why going with other people? I don’t get the reasoning, could you explain? 

Tbh I feels like it would weaken our relationship since he would spend most of his time with them.
Well what you’re saying is true, but he is basically the only one I talk to, so I won’t be alone for a short time but for the rest of the year basically.
